verses.original: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ μέλλοντος κρίνειν ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς καὶ τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Diamartyromai enōpion tou Theou kai Christou Iēsou tou mellontos krinein zōntas kai nekrous kai tēn epiphaneian autou kai tēn basileian autou
verses.literal: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus who will judge the living and the dead and in view of His appearing and His kingdom
verses.literalPt: Eu te conjuro, diante de Deus e de Cristo Jesus, que há de julgar os vivos e os mortos, e pela sua vinda e pelo seu reino:

verses.original: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως ἔλεγξον ἐπιτίμησον παρακάλεσον ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ
verses.transliteration: kēryxon ton logon epistēthi eukairōs akairōs elenxon epitimēson parakaleson en pasē makrothymia kai didachē
verses.literal: Preach the word be prepared in season and out of season reprove rebuke and encourage with every form of patient instruction
verses.literalPt: prega a palavra, insta a tempo e fora de tempo, convence, repreende, exorta com toda a paciência e ensino.

verses.original: Ἔσται γὰρ καιρὸς ὅτε τῆς ὑγιαινούσης διδασκαλίας οὐκ ἀνέξονται ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισωρεύσουσιν διδασκάλους κνηθόμενοι τὴν ἀκοήν
verses.transliteration: Estai gar kairos hote tēs hygiainousēs didaskalias ouk anexontai alla kata tas idias epithymias heautois episōreusousin didaskalous knēthomenoi tēn akoēn
verses.literal: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires
verses.literalPt: Pois virá tempo em que os homens não suportarão a sã doutrina, mas, desejosos de ouvir coisas agradáveis, cercar-se-ão de mestres segundo os seus desejos,

verses.original: καὶ ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀποστρέψουσιν ἐπὶ δὲ τοὺς μύθους ἐκτραπήσονται
verses.transliteration: kai apo men tēs alētheias tēn akoēn apostrepsousin epi de tous mythous ektrapēsontai
verses.literal: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths
verses.literalPt: e desviarão os ouvidos da verdade, e se aplicarão às fábulas.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ νῆφε ἐν πᾶσιν κακοπάθησον ἔργον ποίησον εὐαγγελιστοῦ τὴν διακονίαν σου πληροφόρησον
verses.transliteration: Sy de nēphe en pasin kakopathēson ergon poiēson euangelistou tēn diakonian sou plērophorēson
verses.literal: But you be sober in all things endure hardship do the work of an evangelist fulfill your ministry
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, sê sóbrio em todas as coisas, suporta os sofrimentos, faze a obra dum evangelista, desempenha bem o teu ministério.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ γὰρ ἤδη σπένδομαι καὶ ὁ καιρὸς τῆς ἀναλύσεώς μου ἐφέστηκεν
verses.transliteration: Egō gar ēdē spendomai kai ho kairos tēs analyseōs mou ephestēken
verses.literal: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering and the time of my departure is at hand
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, já estou sendo oferecido, e o tempo da minha partida se aproxima.

verses.original: τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα ἠγώνισμαι τὸν δρόμον τετέλεκα τὴν πίστιν τετήρηκα
verses.transliteration: ton kalon agōna ēgōnismai ton dromon teteleka tēn pistin tetērēka
verses.literal: I have fought the good fight I have finished the race I have kept the faith
verses.literalPt: Tenho pelejado a boa peleja, tenho acabado a carreira, tenho guardado a fé.

verses.original: λοιπὸν ἀπόκειταί μοι ὁ τῆς δικαιοσύνης στέφανος ὃν ἀποδώσει μοι ὁ κύριος ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὁ δίκαιος κριτής οὐ μόνον δὲ ἐμοὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἠγαπηκόσι τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: loipon apokeitai moi ho tēs dikaiosynēs stephanos hon apodōsei moi ho kyrios en ekeinē tē hēmera ho dikaios kritēs ou monon de emoi alla kai pasi tois ēgapēkosi tēn epiphaneian autou
verses.literal: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness which the Lord the righteous Judge will award to me on that day and not only to me but . . . to all who crave His appearing
verses.literalPt: Desde agora me está reservada a coroa da justiça, que o Senhor, justo juiz, me dará naquele Dia; e não somente a mim, mas também a todos aqueles que têm amado a sua vinda.

verses.original: Σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με ταχέως
verses.transliteration: Spoudason elthein pros me tacheōs
verses.literal: Make every effort to come to me quickly
verses.literalPt: Procura vir ter comigo breve.

verses.original: Δημᾶς γάρ με ἐγκατέλιπεν ἀγαπήσας τὸν νῦν αἰῶνα καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Θεσσαλονίκην Κρήσκης εἰς Γαλατίαν Τίτος εἰς Δαλματίαν
verses.transliteration: Dēmas gar me enkatelipen agapēsas ton nyn aiōna kai eporeuthē eis Thessalonikēn Krēskēs eis Galatian Titos eis Dalmatian
verses.literal: because Demas in his love of this world has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica Crescens has gone to Galatia and Titus to Dalmatia
verses.literalPt: Pois Demas me abandonou, tendo amado o mundo presente, e foi para Tessalônica; Crescente para a Galácia, Tito, para a Dalmácia.

verses.original: Λουκᾶς ἐστιν μόνος μετ’ ἐμοῦ Μᾶρκον ἀναλαβὼν ἄγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ ἔστιν γάρ μοι εὔχρηστος εἰς διακονίαν
verses.transliteration: Loukas estin monos met’ emou Markon analabōn age meta seautou estin gar moi euchrēstos eis diakonian
verses.literal: Only Luke is with me Get Mark and bring him with you because he is useful to me in the ministry
verses.literalPt: Só Lucas está comigo. Toma contigo a Marcos e traze-o, porque me é útil para o ministério.

verses.original: Τυχικὸν δὲ ἀπέστειλα εἰς Ἔφεσον
verses.transliteration: Tychikon de apesteila eis Epheson
verses.literal: Tychicus however I have sent to Ephesus
verses.literalPt: Mas a Tíquico, enviei-o a Éfeso.

verses.original: τὸν φαιλόνην ὃν ἀπέλιπον ἐν Τρῳάδι παρὰ Κάρπῳ ἐρχόμενος φέρε καὶ τὰ βιβλία μάλιστα τὰς μεμβράνας
verses.transliteration: ton phailonēn hon apelipon en Trōadi para Karpō erchomenos phere kai ta biblia malista tas membranas
verses.literal: When you come bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas and my scrolls especially the parchments
verses.literalPt: Quando vieres, traze a capa que deixei em Trôade, na casa de Carpo, e os livros, principalmente os pergaminhos.

verses.original: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς πολλά μοι κακὰ ἐνεδείξατο ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Alexandros ho chalkeus polla moi kaka enedeixato apodōsei autō ho Kyrios kata ta erga autou
verses.literal: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me The Lord will repay him according to his deeds
verses.literalPt: Alexandre, o latoeiro, me tem feito muito mal; o Senhor lhe recompensará segundo as suas obras

verses.original: ὃν καὶ σὺ φυλάσσου λίαν γὰρ ἀντέστη τοῖς ἡμετέροις λόγοις
verses.transliteration: hon kai sy phylassou lian gar antestē tois hēmeterois logois
verses.literal: You too should beware of him for he has vigorously opposed our message
verses.literalPt: (tu também guarda-te dele), porque ele resistiu muito às nossas palavras.

verses.original: Ἐν τῇ πρώτῃ μου ἀπολογίᾳ οὐδείς μοι παρεγένετο ἀλλὰ πάντες με ἐγκατέλιπον μὴ αὐτοῖς λογισθείη
verses.transliteration: En tē prōtē mou apologia oudeis moi paregeneto alla pantes me enkatelipon mē autois logistheiē
verses.literal: At my first defense no one stood with me but everyone deserted me May it not be charged against them
verses.literalPt: Ninguém esteve ao meu lado na minha primeira defesa; pelo contrário, todos me desampararam. Que isso não lhes seja imputado.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Κύριός μοι παρέστη καὶ ἐνεδυνάμωσέν με ἵνα δι’ ἐμοῦ τὸ κήρυγμα πληροφορηθῇ καὶ ἀκούσωσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ἐρρύσθην ἐκ στόματος λέοντος
verses.transliteration: ho de Kyrios moi parestē kai enedynamōsen me hina di’ emou to kērygma plērophorēthē kai akousōsin panta ta ethnē kai errysthēn ek stomatos leontos
verses.literal: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles would hear it So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion
verses.literalPt: O Senhor, porém, esteve ao meu lado e me confortou, para que fosse por mim cumprida a pregação e ouvissem todos os gentios. E fui livre da boca do leão.

verses.original: ῥύσεταί με ὁ Κύριος ἀπὸ παντὸς ἔργου πονηροῦ καὶ σώσει εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐπουράνιον ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: rhysetai me ho Kyrios apo pantos ergou ponērou kai sōsei eis tēn basileian autou tēn epouranion hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom To Him be the glory forever and ever Amen
verses.literalPt: O Senhor me livrará de toda obra má e me levará salvo para o seu reino celestial. A ele seja dada glória pelos séculos dos séculos. Amém.

verses.original: Ἄσπασαι Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν καὶ τὸν Ὀνησιφόρου οἶκον
verses.transliteration: Aspasai Priskan kai Akylan kai ton Onēsiphorou oikon
verses.literal: Greet Prisca and Aquila as well as the household of Onesiphorus
verses.literalPt: Saúda a Prisca, a Áquila e à família de Onesíforo.

verses.original: Ἔραστος ἔμεινεν ἐν Κορίνθῳ Τρόφιμον δὲ ἀπέλιπον ἐν Μιλήτῳ ἀσθενοῦντα
verses.transliteration: Erastos emeinen en Korinthō Trophimon de apelipon en Milētō asthenounta
verses.literal: Erastus has remained at Corinth and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus
verses.literalPt: Erasto ficou em Corinto, e deixei Trófimo doente em Mileto.

verses.original: Σπούδασον πρὸ χειμῶνος ἐλθεῖν Ἀσπάζεταί σε Εὔβουλος καὶ Πούδης καὶ Λίνος καὶ Κλαυδία καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ πάντες
verses.transliteration: Spoudason pro cheimōnos elthein Aspazetai se Euboulos kai Poudēs kai Linos kai Klaudia kai hoi adelphoi pantes
verses.literal: Make every effort to come to me before winter Eubulus sends you greetings . . . as do Pudens Linus Claudia and all the brothers
verses.literalPt: Procura vir antes do inverno. Êubulo, Prudente, Lino, Cláudio e todos os irmãos te saúdam.

verses.original: Ὁ Κύριος μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματός σου ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho Kyrios meta tou pneumatos sou hē charis meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The Lord be with your spirit Grace be with you all
verses.literalPt: O Senhor seja com o teu espírito. A graça seja convosco.
